config_version.zh: 配置文件的内部格式版本，供服务器迁移配置使用；不要手动递增或降低它。
config_version.en: Internal configuration format used by server migrations. Do not increment or downgrade it manually.

platform.zh: 管理消息适配器与消息处理规则。连接地址、机器人账号属于适配器；白名单、限流和分段回复属于处理规则。先展开子项再修改，保留其他平台的配置。
platform.en: Configure messaging adapters and message handling. Adapter addresses/accounts are separate from allowlists, rate limits and segmented replies. Edit individual children without replacing other adapters.

platform_settings.zh: 管理消息适配器与消息处理规则。连接地址、机器人账号属于适配器；白名单、限流和分段回复属于处理规则。先展开子项再修改，保留其他平台的配置。
platform_settings.en: Configure messaging adapters and message handling. Adapter addresses/accounts are separate from allowlists, rate limits and segmented replies. Edit individual children without replacing other adapters.

provider_sources.zh: 管理模型服务来源或已配置的模型实例。来源保存服务商地址与认证，模型实例引用来源并选择模型；标识被其他配置引用时不能随意改名。
provider_sources.en: Manage provider sources or configured model instances. Sources define endpoint/authentication; model instances reference a source and model. Renaming an ID can break references.

provider.zh: 管理模型服务来源或已配置的模型实例。来源保存服务商地址与认证，模型实例引用来源并选择模型；标识被其他配置引用时不能随意改名。
provider.en: Manage provider sources or configured model instances. Sources define endpoint/authentication; model instances reference a source and model. Renaming an ID can break references.

provider_settings.zh: 管理默认模型、调用流程及通用行为。展开查看每个子项；改变默认模型前，确认其已创建、启用且具备需要的能力。
provider_settings.en: Configure default model, request flow and general behavior. Expand the children; verify the chosen model exists, is enabled and supports the required capabilities.

general.zh: 管理默认模型、调用流程及通用行为。展开查看每个子项；改变默认模型前，确认其已创建、启用且具备需要的能力。
general.en: Configure default model, request flow and general behavior. Expand the children; verify the chosen model exists, is enabled and supports the required capabilities.

provider_stt_settings.zh: 配置语音识别：选择已配置的语音转文字服务，将收到的语音转成文本后交给后续流程；启用前验证服务可用。
provider_stt_settings.en: Configure speech recognition. Incoming audio is transcribed before later processing. Select a configured STT service and verify it before enabling.

provider_tts_settings.zh: 配置回复的语音合成及默认 TTS 服务；服务端需要可用的音色、凭据和消息平台语音发送能力。
provider_tts_settings.en: Configure reply speech synthesis and default TTS service. The server needs a usable voice, credentials and platform audio support.

provider_ltm_settings.zh: 管理群聊上下文感知、历史记录和主动回复。开启历史采集会保存更多聊天内容，应按需要限制数量。
provider_ltm_settings.en: Manage group context, history and proactive replies. History collection retains more conversation content; set an appropriate limit.

ltm.zh: 管理群聊上下文感知、历史记录和主动回复。开启历史采集会保存更多聊天内容，应按需要限制数量。
ltm.en: Manage group context, history and proactive replies. History collection retains more conversation content; set an appropriate limit.

dashboard.zh: 配置 AstrBot 自身的 Web 管理服务。监听地址、端口、证书等改变后可能需要服务重启，并可能使当前手机连接失效。
dashboard.en: Configure the AstrBot web management server. Binding, port or certificate changes may need a restart and can invalidate this phone connection.

platform_specific.zh: 按消息平台分别配置专用行为；仅对应适配器读取这些选项，不会自动将一种平台的设置应用到另一种平台。
platform_specific.en: Configure platform-specific behavior. Each adapter reads its own options; one platform setting does not automatically apply to others.

persona.zh: 选择已创建的人格标识，用其系统提示词和预置对话约束模型回复。填写人格 ID 而不是整段提示词，编辑提示词请进入人格详情。
persona.en: Select an existing persona by ID to apply its system prompt and preset dialogs. Enter the persona ID, not the prompt text; edit prompts in persona details.

agent.config.persona.persona_id.zh: 选择已创建的人格标识，用其系统提示词和预置对话约束模型回复。填写人格 ID 而不是整段提示词，编辑提示词请进入人格详情。
agent.config.persona.persona_id.en: Select an existing persona by ID to apply its system prompt and preset dialogs. Enter the persona ID, not the prompt text; edit prompts in persona details.

persona_id.zh: 选择已创建的人格标识，用其系统提示词和预置对话约束模型回复。填写人格 ID 而不是整段提示词，编辑提示词请进入人格详情。
persona_id.en: Select an existing persona by ID to apply its system prompt and preset dialogs. Enter the persona ID, not the prompt text; edit prompts in persona details.

system_prompt.zh: 定义人格的角色、目标、语气和行为边界，作为模型的系统提示词。建议分段写明任务与限制；模型是否遵循仍受其能力和服务商规则影响。
system_prompt.en: Define persona role, goals, tone and boundaries as the system prompt. Separate tasks and constraints into paragraphs; compliance still depends on the model and provider.
system_prompt.example: 你是中文助手。先给出结论，再解释必要步骤。不要编造未知事实。

begin_dialogs.zh: 人格预置的示例对话，用于示范问答风格与格式；按服务器定义保留 role/content 结构，避免放入真实私人聊天。
begin_dialogs.en: Preset example dialogs demonstrating persona style and format. Preserve the server role/content structure and avoid real private conversations.

example.content: 你好，有什么可以帮助你？

knowledgebase.zh: 配置知识库检索及关联的集合；检索质量同时取决于文档、嵌入模型、召回数量和重排序，修改前确认所选资源存在。
knowledgebase.en: Configure retrieval and associated knowledge collections. Quality depends on documents, embeddings, retrieval limits and reranking. Verify referenced resources exist.

websearch.zh: 配置模型可使用的网页搜索服务与凭据；需要支持工具调用的执行流程及可访问的搜索服务，启用不保证每次回复都会搜索。
websearch.en: Configure web search service and credentials for model tools. A compatible tool-calling flow and reachable search service are required; enabling does not force a search on every reply.

agent_computer_use.zh: 配置智能体的计算机操作环境与权限。远程沙箱与本机执行的权限范围不同，应先选择运行方式，再配置地址、认证和授权范围。
agent_computer_use.en: Configure computer-use environment and permissions. Remote sandboxes and local execution have different access scopes. Select runtime before endpoint, authentication and permissions.

subagents.zh: 配置子智能体的可用配置与并发限制。主智能体是否委派任务由其执行器与工具决定；并发增加会提高资源消耗。
subagents.en: Configure subagent profiles and concurrency. Delegation depends on the main runner and tools; higher concurrency consumes more resources.

truncate_and_compress.zh: 管理超出上下文时的裁剪或摘要策略。裁剪可能丢失旧消息；摘要会调用模型并增加延迟或费用，需保留足够近期对话。
truncate_and_compress.en: Manage context trimming or summarization. Trimming loses older messages; summarization can add model calls, latency and cost. Retain enough recent turns.

others.zh: 包含其余运行行为与系统选项。逐项阅读帮助后修改；服务器部署相关参数可能需要重启，不要用整个对象覆盖未知字段。
others.en: Contains remaining runtime and system options. Review each child before editing; deployment options can need a restart. Preserve unknown fields.

system.zh: 包含其余运行行为与系统选项。逐项阅读帮助后修改；服务器部署相关参数可能需要重启，不要用整个对象覆盖未知字段。
system.en: Contains remaining runtime and system options. Review each child before editing; deployment options can need a restart. Preserve unknown fields.

admins.zh: 设置管理员用户标识；管理员可调用高权限命令。请使用平台实际用户 ID，可通过 /sid 查询，不要用昵称替代。
admins.en: Set administrator user identifiers granting privileged commands. Use actual platform user IDs (query with /sid), not display names.

whitelist.zh: 控制哪些会话允许机器人响应。当前源码在白名单关闭或列表为空时不拦截，WebChat 也豁免；管理员可由群聊/私聊开关绕过。列表可匹配群号或完整会话来源，通过 /sid 获取，例如 aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789；不要给所有平台强加 group: 前缀。
whitelist.en: Control which sessions may receive replies. In this source baseline, disabled or empty allowlists do not filter; WebChat is exempt. Separate group/private switches can exempt admins. Match a group ID or full unified origin from /sid, e.g. aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789. Do not add group: universally.

platform_settings.enable_id_white_list.zh: 控制哪些会话允许机器人响应。当前源码在白名单关闭或列表为空时不拦截，WebChat 也豁免；管理员可由群聊/私聊开关绕过。列表可匹配群号或完整会话来源，通过 /sid 获取，例如 aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789；不要给所有平台强加 group: 前缀。
platform_settings.enable_id_white_list.en: Control which sessions may receive replies. In this source baseline, disabled or empty allowlists do not filter; WebChat is exempt. Separate group/private switches can exempt admins. Match a group ID or full unified origin from /sid, e.g. aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789. Do not add group: universally.

enable_id_white_list.zh: 控制哪些会话允许机器人响应。当前源码在白名单关闭或列表为空时不拦截，WebChat 也豁免；管理员可由群聊/私聊开关绕过。列表可匹配群号或完整会话来源，通过 /sid 获取，例如 aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789；不要给所有平台强加 group: 前缀。
enable_id_white_list.en: Control which sessions may receive replies. In this source baseline, disabled or empty allowlists do not filter; WebChat is exempt. Separate group/private switches can exempt admins. Match a group ID or full unified origin from /sid, e.g. aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789. Do not add group: universally.

platform_settings.wl_ignore_admin_on_gro.zh: 开启后，管理员的群聊消息跳过会话白名单；不改变普通群成员的白名单规则，也不等于授予所有群成员管理员权限。
platform_settings.wl_ignore_admin_on_gro.en: Allow administrator group messages to bypass the session allowlist. This neither exempts ordinary members nor grants them admin rights.

wl_ignore_admin_on_group.zh: 开启后，管理员的群聊消息跳过会话白名单；不改变普通群成员的白名单规则，也不等于授予所有群成员管理员权限。
wl_ignore_admin_on_group.en: Allow administrator group messages to bypass the session allowlist. This neither exempts ordinary members nor grants them admin rights.

platform_settings.wl_ignore_admin_on_fri.zh: 开启后，管理员私聊消息跳过会话白名单；关闭时仍按该会话是否在名单中判断。
platform_settings.wl_ignore_admin_on_fri.en: Allow administrator private messages to bypass the session allowlist. Otherwise normal session matching applies.

wl_ignore_admin_on_friend.zh: 开启后，管理员私聊消息跳过会话白名单；关闭时仍按该会话是否在名单中判断。
wl_ignore_admin_on_friend.en: Allow administrator private messages to bypass the session allowlist. Otherwise normal session matching applies.

plugin.zh: 管理服务器插件及其启用状态与配置。插件的业务字段由插件作者定义；涉及安装、卸载或启停时先检查依赖和当前服务器权限。
plugin.en: Manage server plugins, enabled state and configuration. Business fields belong to each plugin; check dependencies and permissions before install, removal or activation.

plugins.zh: 管理服务器插件及其启用状态与配置。插件的业务字段由插件作者定义；涉及安装、卸载或启停时先检查依赖和当前服务器权限。
plugins.en: Manage server plugins, enabled state and configuration. Business fields belong to each plugin; check dependencies and permissions before install, removal or activation.

segmented_reply.zh: 将一条回复拆成多段发送。分段规则和间隔共同决定消息数量与节奏；过细分段可能触发平台风控或限流。
segmented_reply.en: Split a reply into multiple outgoing messages. Rules and intervals control count and pacing; excessive splitting may trigger platform limits.

rate_limit.zh: 限制时间窗口内处理的消息数量；超限可以等待或丢弃。窗口与计数需要一起设置，避免将正常消息误判为过量。
rate_limit.en: Limit handled messages within a time window. Excess messages can wait or be discarded. Configure the window and count together to avoid suppressing normal traffic.

platform_settings.rate_limit.time.zh: 速率限制统计窗口，单位为秒；与 count 配合。例如 60 秒内最多处理 20 条，超限行为由 strategy 决定。
platform_settings.rate_limit.time.en: Rate-limit window in seconds, used with count. For example 20 messages per 60 seconds; strategy controls excess traffic.

time.zh: 速率限制统计窗口，单位为秒；与 count 配合。例如 60 秒内最多处理 20 条，超限行为由 strategy 决定。
time.en: Rate-limit window in seconds, used with count. For example 20 messages per 60 seconds; strategy controls excess traffic.

platform_settings.rate_limit.count.zh: 速率限制窗口内允许的消息数，需结合 time 理解；较低值更容易触发等待或丢弃。
platform_settings.rate_limit.count.en: Allowed message count per time window. Lower values trigger waiting or discarding more often.

count.zh: 速率限制窗口内允许的消息数，需结合 time 理解；较低值更容易触发等待或丢弃。
count.en: Allowed message count per time window. Lower values trigger waiting or discarding more often.

platform_settings.rate_limit.strategy.zh: 消息超过速率限制时，stall 表示等待后继续，discard 表示丢弃超限消息。选择等待会增加延迟，丢弃则可能没有回复。
platform_settings.rate_limit.strategy.en: For excess messages, stall waits before continuing; discard drops the message. Waiting adds latency, while dropping can leave it unanswered.

strategy.zh: 消息超过速率限制时，stall 表示等待后继续，discard 表示丢弃超限消息。选择等待会增加延迟，丢弃则可能没有回复。
strategy.en: For excess messages, stall waits before continuing; discard drops the message. Waiting adds latency, while dropping can leave it unanswered.

content_safety.zh: 配置消息与回复内容检查。内置关键词和百度内容审核是不同检查器；百度检查需要服务端安装依赖并填写其应用凭据。
content_safety.en: Configure input/reply content checks. Internal keywords and Baidu moderation are separate checkers. Baidu requires server dependencies and application credentials.

content_safety.also_use_in_response.zh: 同时审核模型输出而不只检查输入；拦截后可能导致没有原始回复，请结合服务器日志排查。
content_safety.also_use_in_response.en: Moderate model output as well as input. Blocking may suppress the original reply; inspect server logs when troubleshooting.

content_safety.internal_keywords.enable.zh: 启用内置关键词检查器，按配置的关键词列表检查内容；仅切换此项不会自动补充词库。
content_safety.internal_keywords.enable.en: Enable the internal keyword checker using its configured list. This switch does not populate the list automatically.

provider_settings.provider_pool.zh: 此字段在当前上游文档中标记为尚未实际使用；不要依赖它实现负载均衡或故障转移，应配置当前执行器支持的模型与回退项。
provider_settings.provider_pool.en: The upstream documentation marks this field as not currently used. Do not rely on it for balancing or failover; configure supported model/fallback options instead.

default_kb_collection.zh: 旧版默认知识库集合。当前源码已标注过时，新配置优先使用知识库名称列表 kb_names；连接旧服务器时保留原有结构，不要直接删除旧值。
default_kb_collection.en: Legacy default knowledge collection, marked obsolete by current source. Prefer kb_names for new configurations; retain the original structure on older servers.

t2i_use_file_service.zh: 文本转图片后通过文件服务提供图片 URL；需要配置可访问的 callback_api_base，接收消息的平台必须能访问该地址，否则图片发送会失败。
t2i_use_file_service.en: Serve text-rendered images through file-service URLs. Configure a reachable callback_api_base; the messaging platform must be able to fetch it or delivery fails.

t2i_word_threshold.zh: 超过该文本长度时尝试将回复转成图片；阈值越低越容易生成图片，仍需图像渲染服务可用，具体计数规则由服务器版本决定。
t2i_word_threshold.en: Length threshold for rendering a reply as an image. Lower values trigger images more often; a working renderer is still required and counting depends on server version.

url.zh: 远程服务的完整 URL，包含协议、主机、端口及路径。MCP 中填写 url 会选择远程连接，未填写时才使用本机 command 启动；地址由 AstrBot 服务器访问。
url.en: Full remote URL including scheme, host, port and path. For MCP, url selects remote transport; command is used only when url is absent. The AstrBot server makes the connection.

command.zh: MCP stdio 服务的启动命令，在 AstrBot 服务器上执行，不是在安卓手机运行。需要该服务器已安装对应程序；与远程 url 连接二选一。
command.en: Command launching an MCP stdio server on the AstrBot host, not the Android phone. The executable must be installed there. Use this instead of a remote url.

args.zh: MCP 启动命令的参数列表，每个参数独占一个列表元素，避免把整条 shell 命令写成一个元素。路径相对于 AstrBot 服务器环境。
args.en: MCP command arguments, one argument per array item. Do not put an entire shell command in one item. Paths refer to the AstrBot server environment.

env.zh: 传给 MCP stdio 子进程的环境变量对象；键为变量名，值为字符串。不要将真实密钥写入公开示例或截图。
env.en: Environment variables for the MCP stdio subprocess. Keys are variable names and values are strings. Keep real credentials out of public examples and screenshots.

headers.zh: 远程 MCP HTTP 请求附带的请求头；仅给受信任的目标发送认证。Authorization 的具体格式以服务要求为准，不能把手机的 AstrBot 登录凭据当成 MCP 密钥。
headers.en: Headers for remote MCP HTTP requests. Send authentication only to trusted targets. Follow the service Authorization format; AstrBot phone login credentials are not MCP service keys.

transport.zh: MCP 远程传输类型：当前实现支持 sse 和 streamable_http；有 url 且未指定时按 SSE 处理。必须与服务端路径和协议一致。
transport.en: MCP remote transport: this source supports sse and streamable_http. With url and no transport, SSE is used. Match the remote path and protocol.

host.zh: 服务监听或连接主机，含义由所在对象决定；0.0.0.0 表示监听全部网卡，不能作为手机连接目标，手机应填写服务器可访问地址。
host.en: Listening or target host according to the containing object. 0.0.0.0 binds all interfaces; it is not a phone connection destination. Use a reachable server address.

tools.zh: 配置当前智能体可用的工具或技能集合；实际调用还取决于插件加载情况、权限和模型工具调用能力。保留服务器返回的条目结构。
tools.en: Configure tools or skills available to an agent. Actual invocation also depends on loaded plugins, permissions and model tool support. Preserve the server item structure.

skills.zh: 配置当前智能体可用的工具或技能集合；实际调用还取决于插件加载情况、权限和模型工具调用能力。保留服务器返回的条目结构。
skills.en: Configure tools or skills available to an agent. Actual invocation also depends on loaded plugins, permissions and model tool support. Preserve the server item structure.

name.zh: 当前资源的名称或唯一标识。名称用于区分条目；作为引用的标识需与其他配置精确一致，重命名前检查模型、人格或平台的引用。
name.en: Resource name or unique identifier. Referenced IDs must match other settings exactly. Check model, persona and platform references before renaming.

id.zh: 当前资源的名称或唯一标识。名称用于区分条目；作为引用的标识需与其他配置精确一致，重命名前检查模型、人格或平台的引用。
id.en: Resource name or unique identifier. Referenced IDs must match other settings exactly. Check model, persona and platform references before renaming.

identifier.zh: 在发送给模型的用户提示词前附加用户 ID，帮助区分群成员；开启后会把该标识提供给模型服务，不会更改平台中的用户 ID。
identifier.en: Prefix model user prompts with the sender ID to distinguish participants. Enabling shares this identifier with the model service; it does not change the platform user ID.

type.zh: 指定当前条目的实现或能力类型，含义取决于所在平台、模型或子配置。优先从服务器返回的可选项选择，不要把展示名称当作类型标识。
type.en: Select implementation or capability type for this item. Meaning depends on platform, model or nested configuration. Prefer server options rather than display names.

provider_type.zh: 指定当前条目的实现或能力类型，含义取决于所在平台、模型或子配置。优先从服务器返回的可选项选择，不要把展示名称当作类型标识。
provider_type.en: Select implementation or capability type for this item. Meaning depends on platform, model or nested configuration. Prefer server options rather than display names.

enable.zh: 控制当前条目是否启用，作用范围仅为所在对象；启用前先完成必需配置，关闭不会自动删除该条目的设置。
enable.en: Enable this item within its containing object. Complete required configuration first; disabling does not automatically erase its settings.

enabled.zh: 控制当前条目是否启用，作用范围仅为所在对象；启用前先完成必需配置，关闭不会自动删除该条目的设置。
enabled.en: Enable this item within its containing object. Complete required configuration first; disabling does not automatically erase its settings.

active.zh: 控制当前条目是否启用，作用范围仅为所在对象；启用前先完成必需配置，关闭不会自动删除该条目的设置。
active.en: Enable this item within its containing object. Complete required configuration first; disabling does not automatically erase its settings.

api_base.zh: 对应模型或嵌入/重排序服务的基础地址，在 AstrBot 服务器侧访问。是否需要 /v1 等路径取决于服务兼容协议，不要重复拼接接口路径。
api_base.en: Base endpoint for the model, embedding or rerank service, accessed by the AstrBot host. Whether /v1 is needed depends on the provider protocol; avoid duplicate endpoint paths.

embedding_api_base.zh: 对应模型或嵌入/重排序服务的基础地址，在 AstrBot 服务器侧访问。是否需要 /v1 等路径取决于服务兼容协议，不要重复拼接接口路径。
embedding_api_base.en: Base endpoint for the model, embedding or rerank service, accessed by the AstrBot host. Whether /v1 is needed depends on the provider protocol; avoid duplicate endpoint paths.

nvidia_rerank_api_base.zh: 对应模型或嵌入/重排序服务的基础地址，在 AstrBot 服务器侧访问。是否需要 /v1 等路径取决于服务兼容协议，不要重复拼接接口路径。
nvidia_rerank_api_base.en: Base endpoint for the model, embedding or rerank service, accessed by the AstrBot host. Whether /v1 is needed depends on the provider protocol; avoid duplicate endpoint paths.

content_safety.baidu_aip.app_id.zh: 百度智能云内容审核应用的 App ID，与该应用的 API Key 和 Secret Key 配套使用；不是 AstrBot 插件标识。
content_safety.baidu_aip.app_id.en: Baidu content moderation application App ID, paired with its API Key and Secret Key; not an AstrBot plugin identifier.

lark_connection_mode.zh: 飞书事件接收方式，按适配器选项选择 WebSocket 长连接或回调方式；回调方式需要飞书能够访问服务器配置的地址。
lark_connection_mode.en: Lark event subscription mode: select the adapter-supported WebSocket or callback option. Callbacks require a server address reachable by Lark.

is_sandbox.zh: 启用当前平台适配器的沙箱环境，用于测试账号和接口；生产与沙箱的账号、凭据及地址可能不同，需配套配置。
is_sandbox.en: Use this platform adapter sandbox environment for test accounts and APIs. Production and sandbox credentials/endpoints may differ.

active_send_mode.zh: 切换适配器的主动发送接口；是否可用取决于平台权限与机器人类型，开启后不代表可以绕过平台的主动消息限制。
active_send_mode.en: Switch to the adapter proactive-send API. Availability depends on platform permissions and bot type; enabling does not bypass platform messaging limits.

ws_reverse_port.zh: 反向 WebSocket 服务在 AstrBot 主机监听的端口。机器人客户端需要连接到该主机和端口；检查端口占用、防火墙及容器映射。
ws_reverse_port.en: Reverse WebSocket listening port on the AstrBot host. The bot client connects there; check conflicts, firewall rules and container port mapping.

genie_language.zh: 发送给 Genie 语音合成服务的语言标识；应与文本语言及服务支持的代码匹配，选错可能影响发音。
genie_language.en: Language code sent to Genie TTS. Match the text and codes supported by that service; a mismatch can affect pronunciation.

rerank_model.zh: 用于重排检索候选的模型名称，需与重排序提供商支持的模型标识精确一致；不是聊天模型的展示名称。
rerank_model.en: Model identifier used to rerank retrieved candidates. Match a model supported by the rerank provider, not a chat-model display name.

dashscope_tts_voice.zh: 百炼语音合成的音色标识；音色需与所选模型兼容，填写服务文档中的标识而不是自行起名。
dashscope_tts_voice.en: DashScope TTS voice identifier. It must be compatible with the selected model; use a service-documented identifier.

gm_thinking_config.zh: 当前模型的思考参数对象，子项由 Gemini 或 Anthropic 协议定义。模型不支持时可能拒绝请求；保留服务端结构并单独调整预算或模式。
gm_thinking_config.en: Model thinking configuration defined by Gemini or Anthropic. Unsupported models may reject it. Preserve structure and edit the budget/mode children individually.

anth_thinking_config.zh: 当前模型的思考参数对象，子项由 Gemini 或 Anthropic 协议定义。模型不支持时可能拒绝请求；保留服务端结构并单独调整预算或模式。
anth_thinking_config.en: Model thinking configuration defined by Gemini or Anthropic. Unsupported models may reject it. Preserve structure and edit the budget/mode children individually.

agent.runtime.zh: 选择智能体执行器；astrbot 使用本地智能体流程，Dify、Coze、百炼、DeerFlow 则使用各自服务。切换后需在对应配置组填写完整凭据与应用参数。
agent.runtime.en: Select agent runner. astrbot uses the local flow; Dify, Coze, DashScope and DeerFlow use their respective services. Fill the matching service configuration when switching.

runtime.zh: 选择智能体执行器；astrbot 使用本地智能体流程，Dify、Coze、百炼、DeerFlow 则使用各自服务。切换后需在对应配置组填写完整凭据与应用参数。
runtime.en: Select agent runner. astrbot uses the local flow; Dify, Coze, DashScope and DeerFlow use their respective services. Fill the matching service configuration when switching.

dify_runner.zh: 配置对应远程智能体执行器；仅在选用该执行器时读取其配置。服务地址、应用标识和密钥需要来自同一个服务环境。
dify_runner.en: Configure this remote agent runner. These settings are used when that runner is selected. Endpoint, application ID and credentials must refer to the same environment.

coze_runner.zh: 配置对应远程智能体执行器；仅在选用该执行器时读取其配置。服务地址、应用标识和密钥需要来自同一个服务环境。
coze_runner.en: Configure this remote agent runner. These settings are used when that runner is selected. Endpoint, application ID and credentials must refer to the same environment.

dashscope_runner.zh: 配置对应远程智能体执行器；仅在选用该执行器时读取其配置。服务地址、应用标识和密钥需要来自同一个服务环境。
dashscope_runner.en: Configure this remote agent runner. These settings are used when that runner is selected. Endpoint, application ID and credentials must refer to the same environment.

deerflow_runner.zh: 配置对应远程智能体执行器；仅在选用该执行器时读取其配置。服务地址、应用标识和密钥需要来自同一个服务环境。
deerflow_runner.en: Configure this remote agent runner. These settings are used when that runner is selected. Endpoint, application ID and credentials must refer to the same environment.

agent.config.dify_api_type.zh: Dify 应用接口类型，聊天与工作流的请求/响应结构不同；选择应与 Dify 已发布的应用类型一致。
agent.config.dify_api_type.en: Dify application API type. Chat and workflow payloads differ; match the published Dify application type.

agent.config.dify_api_base.zh: 对应远程执行器的服务基础地址；由 AstrBot 主机发起访问，填写部署文档规定的前缀并确认网络可达。
agent.config.dify_api_base.en: Base endpoint for this remote runner, accessed by the AstrBot host. Use the prefix documented by your deployment and verify reachability.

agent.config.coze_api_base.zh: 对应远程执行器的服务基础地址；由 AstrBot 主机发起访问，填写部署文档规定的前缀并确认网络可达。
agent.config.coze_api_base.en: Base endpoint for this remote runner, accessed by the AstrBot host. Use the prefix documented by your deployment and verify reachability.

agent.config.deerflow_api_base.zh: 对应远程执行器的服务基础地址；由 AstrBot 主机发起访问，填写部署文档规定的前缀并确认网络可达。
agent.config.deerflow_api_base.en: Base endpoint for this remote runner, accessed by the AstrBot host. Use the prefix documented by your deployment and verify reachability.

agent.config.dify_api_key.zh: 所选远程执行器的应用认证密钥，必须与其应用/助手 ID 和服务地址匹配；无权限时应检查该服务的授权，不要改用 AstrBot 登录密钥。
agent.config.dify_api_key.en: Application credential for the selected remote runner. It must match the application/assistant ID and endpoint. Check service authorization on failures, not the AstrBot login key.

agent.config.coze_api_key.zh: 所选远程执行器的应用认证密钥，必须与其应用/助手 ID 和服务地址匹配；无权限时应检查该服务的授权，不要改用 AstrBot 登录密钥。
agent.config.coze_api_key.en: Application credential for the selected remote runner. It must match the application/assistant ID and endpoint. Check service authorization on failures, not the AstrBot login key.

agent.config.dashscope_api_key.zh: 所选远程执行器的应用认证密钥，必须与其应用/助手 ID 和服务地址匹配；无权限时应检查该服务的授权，不要改用 AstrBot 登录密钥。
agent.config.dashscope_api_key.en: Application credential for the selected remote runner. It must match the application/assistant ID and endpoint. Check service authorization on failures, not the AstrBot login key.

agent.config.deerflow_api_key.zh: 所选远程执行器的应用认证密钥，必须与其应用/助手 ID 和服务地址匹配；无权限时应检查该服务的授权，不要改用 AstrBot 登录密钥。
agent.config.deerflow_api_key.en: Application credential for the selected remote runner. It must match the application/assistant ID and endpoint. Check service authorization on failures, not the AstrBot login key.

agent.config.dify_workflow_output_key.zh: Dify 工作流输出中作为机器人回复读取的变量名；需要与你的工作流终点输出字段一致，否则可能无法取得回复。
agent.config.dify_workflow_output_key.en: Dify workflow output variable used as the bot reply. Match the workflow end-node output field or the reply may be missing.

agent.config.dify_query_input_key.zh: Dify 工作流接收用户消息的输入变量名，需在工作流中声明同名输入；不是要发送的实际消息。
agent.config.dify_query_input_key.en: Dify workflow input variable receiving the user message. Declare the same input in the workflow; this is a variable name, not message content.

agent.config.variables.zh: 附加给远程执行器的输入变量对象；键需与应用声明的变量一致，值的类型由应用决定。不要覆盖执行器自动注入的消息字段。
agent.config.variables.en: Additional input variables for the remote runner. Match application-declared names and types; do not overwrite automatically supplied message fields.

agent.config.timeout.zh: 等待远程执行或工具调用完成的超时时间，单位为秒；增大会延长等待，占用资源也更久，不能修复无法访问的地址。
agent.config.timeout.en: Timeout for remote execution or tool calls, in seconds. Increasing it allows longer waits and resource use; it cannot fix an unreachable endpoint.

tool_call_timeout.zh: 等待远程执行或工具调用完成的超时时间，单位为秒；增大会延长等待，占用资源也更久，不能修复无法访问的地址。
tool_call_timeout.en: Timeout for remote execution or tool calls, in seconds. Increasing it allows longer waits and resource use; it cannot fix an unreachable endpoint.

agent.config.misc.tool_call_timeout.zh: 等待远程执行或工具调用完成的超时时间，单位为秒；增大会延长等待，占用资源也更久，不能修复无法访问的地址。
agent.config.misc.tool_call_timeout.en: Timeout for remote execution or tool calls, in seconds. Increasing it allows longer waits and resource use; it cannot fix an unreachable endpoint.

agent.config.proxy.zh: 远程执行器请求使用的网络代理地址；由 AstrBot 主机连接，代理需要支持所用协议。留空时按执行器默认网络方式处理。
agent.config.proxy.en: Network proxy for remote runner requests, connected from the AstrBot host. It must support the required protocol. Empty uses the runner default network behavior.

agent.config.bot_id.zh: 远程服务中已创建并发布的机器人、应用或助手 ID；从对应控制台复制，不能使用本地展示名称代替。
agent.config.bot_id.en: Identifier of the published bot, application or assistant on the remote service. Copy it from that console rather than using a local display name.

agent.config.dashscope_app_id.zh: 远程服务中已创建并发布的机器人、应用或助手 ID；从对应控制台复制，不能使用本地展示名称代替。
agent.config.dashscope_app_id.en: Identifier of the published bot, application or assistant on the remote service. Copy it from that console rather than using a local display name.

dashscope_app_id.zh: 远程服务中已创建并发布的机器人、应用或助手 ID；从对应控制台复制，不能使用本地展示名称代替。
dashscope_app_id.en: Identifier of the published bot, application or assistant on the remote service. Copy it from that console rather than using a local display name.

agent.config.deerflow_assistant_id.zh: 远程服务中已创建并发布的机器人、应用或助手 ID；从对应控制台复制，不能使用本地展示名称代替。
agent.config.deerflow_assistant_id.en: Identifier of the published bot, application or assistant on the remote service. Copy it from that console rather than using a local display name.

agent.config.auto_save_history.zh: 由 Coze 服务管理对话历史，影响后续请求是否延续远程会话；与 AstrBot 本地上下文不是同一份记录。
agent.config.auto_save_history.en: Let Coze manage conversation history and continuation of remote sessions. This history is separate from AstrBot local context.

agent.config.dashscope_app_type.zh: 百炼应用类型，选择与控制台创建的应用相同的类型，避免聊天与工作流请求参数不匹配。
agent.config.dashscope_app_type.en: DashScope application type. Match the console application to avoid mismatched chat/workflow request parameters.

agent.config.rag_options.pipeline_ids.zh: 百炼应用检索范围的知识库 Pipeline 或文件 ID 列表；仅填写该应用有权限访问的资源，空列表的行为由服务端应用决定。
agent.config.rag_options.pipeline_ids.en: DashScope retrieval pipeline or file IDs. Use resources accessible to this application; empty-list behavior is determined by the service.

agent.config.rag_options.file_ids.zh: 百炼应用检索范围的知识库 Pipeline 或文件 ID 列表；仅填写该应用有权限访问的资源，空列表的行为由服务端应用决定。
agent.config.rag_options.file_ids.en: DashScope retrieval pipeline or file IDs. Use resources accessible to this application; empty-list behavior is determined by the service.

agent.config.rag_options.output_referenc.zh: 请求百炼返回检索引用，便于核对回答来源；是否展示完整引用还取决于应用与回复渲染支持。
agent.config.rag_options.output_referenc.en: Request retrieval references from DashScope. Complete reference display also depends on application and reply rendering support.

agent.config.deerflow_auth_header.zh: 发送 DeerFlow 认证时使用的 HTTP 头名称；需与网关或部署配置一致，名称与 API key 的值是两个不同字段。
agent.config.deerflow_auth_header.en: HTTP header name for DeerFlow authentication. Match gateway/deployment configuration; header name and credential value are separate fields.

agent.config.deerflow_model_name.zh: 覆盖 DeerFlow 使用的模型名称，需为远程服务已配置的模型标识；留空时是否使用服务默认值由执行器决定。
agent.config.deerflow_model_name.en: Override DeerFlow model name with an identifier configured remotely. Empty-value default behavior is determined by the runner.

deerflow_thinking_enabled.zh: 请求 DeerFlow 使用思考模式；需要服务和模型支持，可能增加响应时间及模型消耗。
deerflow_thinking_enabled.en: Request DeerFlow thinking mode. Requires service/model support and may increase latency and model usage.

agent.config.deerflow_thinking_enabled.zh: 请求 DeerFlow 使用思考模式；需要服务和模型支持，可能增加响应时间及模型消耗。
agent.config.deerflow_thinking_enabled.en: Request DeerFlow thinking mode. Requires service/model support and may increase latency and model usage.

agent.config.deerflow_plan_mode.zh: 请求 DeerFlow 先进行任务规划；适用于复杂任务，可能增加步骤与等待时间，具体执行由远程服务决定。
agent.config.deerflow_plan_mode.en: Request DeerFlow task planning. Useful for complex tasks, with potentially more steps and latency; execution is controlled remotely.

agent.config.deerflow_subagent_enabled.zh: 允许 DeerFlow 调用子智能体协作；远程服务必须支持，开启后可能增加并发请求和模型消耗。
agent.config.deerflow_subagent_enabled.en: Allow DeerFlow subagent delegation. The remote service must support it; this can increase concurrency and model usage.

agent.config.deerflow_max_concurrent_sub.zh: DeerFlow 同时运行的子智能体上限；提高可并行处理更多任务，也会消耗更多远程资源。
agent.config.deerflow_max_concurrent_sub.en: Maximum concurrent DeerFlow subagents. Higher limits allow more parallel work but consume more remote resources.

agent.config.deerflow_recursion_limit.zh: DeerFlow 执行图的递归/步骤深度限制，用于约束持续执行；过小会提前终止复杂任务，过大会延长运行。
agent.config.deerflow_recursion_limit.en: DeerFlow execution graph recursion/step depth limit. Low values can stop complex tasks early; high values allow longer runs.

provider_settings.web_search.zh: 为智能体开放网页搜索工具；需要配置可用的搜索提供商及凭据，模型自行决定是否调用，不保证每条消息都联网。
provider_settings.web_search.en: Expose web search tools to the agent. Configure a working search provider and credentials; the model decides whether to invoke it.

web_search.zh: 为智能体开放网页搜索工具；需要配置可用的搜索提供商及凭据，模型自行决定是否调用，不保证每条消息都联网。
web_search.en: Expose web search tools to the agent. Configure a working search provider and credentials; the model decides whether to invoke it.

provider_settings.websearch_provider.zh: 选择网页搜索后端；与该后端的 API Key 一起配置，不同搜索商返回质量、额度与计费方式不同。
provider_settings.websearch_provider.en: Select web search backend with its matching API key. Results, quotas and pricing differ by service.

websearch_provider.zh: 选择网页搜索后端；与该后端的 API Key 一起配置，不同搜索商返回质量、额度与计费方式不同。
websearch_provider.en: Select web search backend with its matching API key. Results, quotas and pricing differ by service.

provider_settings.web_search_link.zh: 控制网页搜索结果引用链接的输出，便于查证来源；开启不能保证模型生成的每个陈述都有对应来源。
provider_settings.web_search_link.en: Control output of source links from web search. Links help verification but do not guarantee every model claim has a source.

web_search_link.zh: 控制网页搜索结果引用链接的输出，便于查证来源；开启不能保证模型生成的每个陈述都有对应来源。
web_search_link.en: Control output of source links from web search. Links help verification but do not guarantee every model claim has a source.

provider_settings.computer_use_local_per.zh: 控制本机计算机操作或文件访问范围；修改前确认授权目录和可执行操作，避免把整个宿主机范围授予不需要的任务。
provider_settings.computer_use_local_per.en: Control local computer-use or filesystem access scope. Check permitted directories and operations before expanding access to the host.

computer_use_local_permissions.zh: 控制本机计算机操作或文件访问范围；修改前确认授权目录和可执行操作，避免把整个宿主机范围授予不需要的任务。
computer_use_local_permissions.en: Control local computer-use or filesystem access scope. Check permitted directories and operations before expanding access to the host.

filesystem_scope.zh: 控制本机计算机操作或文件访问范围；修改前确认授权目录和可执行操作，避免把整个宿主机范围授予不需要的任务。
filesystem_scope.en: Control local computer-use or filesystem access scope. Check permitted directories and operations before expanding access to the host.

provider_settings.sandbox.booter.zh: 选择远程沙箱环境的启动驱动；对应的端点、认证和生命周期参数应与该驱动一起配置。
provider_settings.sandbox.booter.en: Select sandbox launcher/driver. Configure endpoint, authentication and lifecycle parameters for that driver.

booter.zh: 选择远程沙箱环境的启动驱动；对应的端点、认证和生命周期参数应与该驱动一起配置。
booter.en: Select sandbox launcher/driver. Configure endpoint, authentication and lifecycle parameters for that driver.

agent.config.misc.max_steps.zh: 限制一轮智能体响应中的工具调用迭代次数。较小可防止长时间循环，较大会允许更复杂任务并增加延迟与消耗。
agent.config.misc.max_steps.en: Maximum tool-call iterations in one agent response. Lower limits prevent long loops; higher limits permit complex tasks with more latency and usage.

max_steps.zh: 限制一轮智能体响应中的工具调用迭代次数。较小可防止长时间循环，较大会允许更复杂任务并增加延迟与消耗。
max_steps.en: Maximum tool-call iterations in one agent response. Lower limits prevent long loops; higher limits permit complex tasks with more latency and usage.

provider_tts_settings.dual_output.zh: 开启语音合成时同时保留文字回复；关闭时输出方式由 TTS 流程决定。双输出可能增加平台消息数量。
provider_tts_settings.dual_output.en: Keep a text reply alongside synthesized audio. When disabled, output follows the TTS flow. Dual output can increase outgoing message count.

dual_output.zh: 开启语音合成时同时保留文字回复；关闭时输出方式由 TTS 流程决定。双输出可能增加平台消息数量。
dual_output.en: Keep a text reply alongside synthesized audio. When disabled, output follows the TTS flow. Dual output can increase outgoing message count.

platform_settings.ignore_bot_self_messag.zh: 忽略机器人自己发送的消息，避免自我回复循环；关闭前确认适配器能够区分消息来源。
platform_settings.ignore_bot_self_messag.en: Ignore bot-authored messages to avoid reply loops. Verify adapter source detection before disabling.

platform_settings.ignore_at_all.zh: 控制是否忽略群内 @全体成员事件，减少由广播提及触发的处理；不等于关闭普通 @机器人 消息。
platform_settings.ignore_at_all.en: Ignore group mention-everyone events to reduce broadcast triggers. This is separate from direct mentions of the bot.

platform_settings.no_permission_reply.zh: 用户尝试执行无权限操作时是否发送权限提示；关闭后可能静默拒绝，不会改变真实授权结果。
platform_settings.no_permission_reply.en: Reply with a permission notice when an unauthorized action is attempted. Disabling can make rejection silent; it does not change authorization.

platform_specific.lark.pre_ack_emoji.ena.zh: 处理消息前添加平台支持的表情回应，提示机器人已收到消息。需要平台 API 与机器人权限支持；不代表模型已生成答案。
platform_specific.lark.pre_ack_emoji.ena.en: Add a platform reaction before processing to acknowledge receipt. Requires platform API/permission support; it does not mean the model answer is ready.

platform_specific.telegram.pre_ack_emoji.zh: 处理消息前添加平台支持的表情回应，提示机器人已收到消息。需要平台 API 与机器人权限支持；不代表模型已生成答案。
platform_specific.telegram.pre_ack_emoji.en: Add a platform reaction before processing to acknowledge receipt. Requires platform API/permission support; it does not mean the model answer is ready.

platform_specific.discord.pre_ack_emoji..zh: 处理消息前添加平台支持的表情回应，提示机器人已收到消息。需要平台 API 与机器人权限支持；不代表模型已生成答案。
platform_specific.discord.pre_ack_emoji..en: Add a platform reaction before processing to acknowledge receipt. Requires platform API/permission support; it does not mean the model answer is ready.

platform_settings.segmented_reply.only_l.zh: 仅对模型生成的回复进行分段，避免插件或命令原本的消息格式被拆开；关闭后适用范围更广。
platform_settings.segmented_reply.only_l.en: Split only model-generated replies to preserve plugin/command formatting. Disabling broadens the scope.

only_llm_result.zh: 仅对模型生成的回复进行分段，避免插件或命令原本的消息格式被拆开；关闭后适用范围更广。
only_llm_result.en: Split only model-generated replies to preserve plugin/command formatting. Disabling broadens the scope.

platform_settings.segmented_reply.split_.zh: 选择分段规则；正则与分隔词方式需要填写相应子项。先用典型长回复验证，避免把代码、链接或数字拆坏。
platform_settings.segmented_reply.split_.en: Select splitting rule and configure the matching regex/delimiter fields. Test representative replies to avoid breaking code, links or numbers.

split_mode.zh: 选择分段规则；正则与分隔词方式需要填写相应子项。先用典型长回复验证，避免把代码、链接或数字拆坏。
split_mode.en: Select splitting rule and configure the matching regex/delimiter fields. Test representative replies to avoid breaking code, links or numbers.

provider_ltm_settings.active_reply.metho.zh: 选择当前功能的实现策略，取值由所在对象和服务器可选项决定。群聊主动回复策略会影响触发条件；不要把其他配置组的同名 method 值直接复制过来。
provider_ltm_settings.active_reply.metho.en: Select implementation strategy from this object server options. Proactive group-reply strategy affects triggering; a method value from another group may have a different meaning.

method.zh: 选择当前功能的实现策略，取值由所在对象和服务器可选项决定。群聊主动回复策略会影响触发条件；不要把其他配置组的同名 method 值直接复制过来。
method.en: Select implementation strategy from this object server options. Proactive group-reply strategy affects triggering; a method value from another group may have a different meaning.

interval_method.zh: 分段发送间隔的计算方式，配合 interval、log_base 等选项控制节奏；请使用当前服务器返回的可选值。
interval_method.en: How segmented-message delays are calculated, together with interval/log_base settings. Use the current server option values.

gsv_top_k.zh: 限制 GPT-SoVITS 每步采样的候选数量；较小通常更保守。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_top_k.en: Limit candidate count per GPT-SoVITS sampling step; lower values are usually more conservative. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_top_p.zh: GPT-SoVITS 核采样概率阈值；调整会影响语音生成的多样性。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_top_p.en: GPT-SoVITS nucleus sampling probability threshold affecting generation diversity. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_temperature.zh: GPT-SoVITS 采样温度；提高通常增加随机性，也可能降低稳定性。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_temperature.en: GPT-SoVITS sampling temperature; higher values usually increase randomness and can reduce stability. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_batch_size.zh: GPT-SoVITS 推理批大小；增大可提高吞吐，也可能增加显存占用。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_batch_size.en: GPT-SoVITS inference batch size; larger batches may improve throughput and increase memory use. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_batch_threshold.zh: GPT-SoVITS 批处理阈值参数，按所部署服务的 API 定义调节。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_batch_threshold.en: GPT-SoVITS batching threshold, interpreted by the deployed service API. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_split_bucket.zh: GPT-SoVITS 按文本长度分桶以便批量处理，实际效果取决于服务实现。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_split_bucket.en: GPT-SoVITS text-length bucketing for batched processing; behavior depends on service implementation. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_fragment_interval.zh: GPT-SoVITS 语音片段间隔，单位为秒；过长会使拼接停顿明显。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_fragment_interval.en: GPT-SoVITS gap between audio fragments in seconds; long gaps produce noticeable pauses. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_streaming_mode.zh: 向 GPT-SoVITS 请求流式输出；当前客户端与服务器都需支持对应响应格式。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_streaming_mode.en: Request GPT-SoVITS streaming output; client and server must support its response format. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_parallel_infer.zh: 启用 GPT-SoVITS 并行推理，可能提高速度并增加资源占用。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_parallel_infer.en: Enable GPT-SoVITS parallel inference, potentially improving speed and resource usage. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

gsv_repetition_penalty.zh: GPT-SoVITS 重复惩罚系数；调整用于减少重复，过大可能影响自然度。 参数传给语音服务，范围与兼容性以你部署的 GPT-SoVITS 版本为准。
gsv_repetition_penalty.en: GPT-SoVITS repetition penalty; reducing repetition too aggressively may affect naturalness. The value is passed to the speech service; supported ranges depend on your deployed GPT-SoVITS version.

version.zh: 服务器报告的软件或前端版本，用于排查接口兼容问题；这是状态信息，修改显示值不会升级服务器。
version.en: Server-reported software/frontend version used for compatibility troubleshooting. Editing a displayed value does not upgrade the server.

webui_version.zh: 服务器报告的软件或前端版本，用于排查接口兼容问题；这是状态信息，修改显示值不会升级服务器。
webui_version.en: Server-reported software/frontend version used for compatibility troubleshooting. Editing a displayed value does not upgrade the server.

dashboard_version.zh: 服务器报告的软件或前端版本，用于排查接口兼容问题；这是状态信息，修改显示值不会升级服务器。
dashboard_version.en: Server-reported software/frontend version used for compatibility troubleshooting. Editing a displayed value does not upgrade the server.

astrbot_version.zh: 服务器报告的软件或前端版本，用于排查接口兼容问题；这是状态信息，修改显示值不会升级服务器。
astrbot_version.en: Server-reported software/frontend version used for compatibility troubleshooting. Editing a displayed value does not upgrade the server.

astrbot_code_version.zh: 服务器报告的软件或前端版本，用于排查接口兼容问题；这是状态信息，修改显示值不会升级服务器。
astrbot_code_version.en: Server-reported software/frontend version used for compatibility troubleshooting. Editing a displayed value does not upgrade the server.

uptime.zh: 服务器进程已运行的持续时间，可能由时、分、秒组成。应用会组合显示为可读时长；重启进程后重新计时，不是开机日历时间。
uptime.en: Elapsed server process uptime, sometimes split into hours/minutes/seconds. Displayed as a duration and reset on restart, not a calendar date.

running.zh: 服务器进程已运行的持续时间，可能由时、分、秒组成。应用会组合显示为可读时长；重启进程后重新计时，不是开机日历时间。
running.en: Elapsed server process uptime, sometimes split into hours/minutes/seconds. Displayed as a duration and reset on restart, not a calendar date.

start_time.zh: 服务器进程启动时间；Unix 秒或毫秒时间戳由应用格式化到手机时区。设备时区变化会改变显示时间，不改变原始时间点。
start_time.en: Process start timestamp. Unix seconds/milliseconds are formatted in the phone time zone; changing the zone changes display, not the instant.

cpu_percent.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
cpu_percent.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

cpu_usage.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
cpu_usage.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

memory_percent.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
memory_percent.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

disk_percent.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
disk_percent.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

used_percent.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
used_percent.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

usage_percent.zh: 服务器报告的资源使用百分比。进度条按 0–100 展示，原始数值仍保留；缺失值不当作 0，多核 CPU 的上限可能取决于服务器统计方式。
usage_percent.en: Server-reported resource percentage. Progress uses 0–100 while retaining the value. Missing is not zero; multicore CPU scaling depends on server reporting.

memory.zh: 内存统计对象。旧接口 process 表示进程内存、system 表示系统总内存，单位 MiB；system 不是系统已用量。应用据此换算，不能混同于字节字段。
memory.en: Memory statistics. Legacy process is process memory and system is total system memory, in MiB; system is not used RAM. These differ from explicit byte fields.

memory.process.zh: AstrBot 进程正在使用的内存。旧状态接口以 MiB 返回，例如 660 表示 660 MiB；应用会换算容量并用系统总量计算进程占比。这不是整个系统已用内存。
memory.process.en: Memory used by the AstrBot process. The legacy status API reports MiB: 660 means 660 MiB. The app formats capacity and computes the process share against system total. This is not total system memory usage.

memory.system.zh: 服务器系统的总内存容量。旧状态接口以 MiB 返回，例如 1699 表示 1699 MiB；此值不是系统已用量，也不是进程使用量，不能将其直接显示为内存使用率。
memory.system.en: Total server system memory capacity. The legacy API reports MiB: 1699 means 1699 MiB. This is neither system used memory nor process usage, and is not itself a utilization percentage.

process_memory_bytes.zh: 明确以字节为单位的内存或磁盘统计；应用换算成易读容量。used 是已用、total 是总量，缺失项不会自动补零。
process_memory_bytes.en: Explicit byte-valued memory/disk statistic, formatted as readable capacity. used means occupied and total means capacity; absent values are not filled with zero.

memory_used_bytes.zh: 明确以字节为单位的内存或磁盘统计；应用换算成易读容量。used 是已用、total 是总量，缺失项不会自动补零。
memory_used_bytes.en: Explicit byte-valued memory/disk statistic, formatted as readable capacity. used means occupied and total means capacity; absent values are not filled with zero.

memory_total_bytes.zh: 明确以字节为单位的内存或磁盘统计；应用换算成易读容量。used 是已用、total 是总量，缺失项不会自动补零。
memory_total_bytes.en: Explicit byte-valued memory/disk statistic, formatted as readable capacity. used means occupied and total means capacity; absent values are not filled with zero.

disk_used_bytes.zh: 明确以字节为单位的内存或磁盘统计；应用换算成易读容量。used 是已用、total 是总量，缺失项不会自动补零。
disk_used_bytes.en: Explicit byte-valued memory/disk statistic, formatted as readable capacity. used means occupied and total means capacity; absent values are not filled with zero.

disk_total_bytes.zh: 明确以字节为单位的内存或磁盘统计；应用换算成易读容量。used 是已用、total 是总量，缺失项不会自动补零。
disk_total_bytes.en: Explicit byte-valued memory/disk statistic, formatted as readable capacity. used means occupied and total means capacity; absent values are not filled with zero.

storage.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
storage.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

disk.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
disk.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

used.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
used.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

total.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
total.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

free.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
free.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

available.zh: 存储或资源容量统计，含义和单位需结合父级字段。used 为已用、total 为总量、free 为未分配、available 为可用；不要把无单位数值默认当成百分比。
available.en: Capacity statistic interpreted with its parent and units. used is occupied, total capacity, free unallocated and available usable. Unitless values are not automatically percentages.

thread_count.zh: 服务器进程的线程数量，用于观察并发与资源变化；线程数不等于在线用户数或处理中的消息数。
thread_count.en: Server process thread count for observing concurrency/resources; not the count of online users or active messages.

platform_count.zh: 状态接口报告的平台、插件或消息数量；累计口径与重启后是否清零取决于接口版本，不能用插件数量推断全部已启用。
platform_count.en: Platform, plugin or message count reported by the status API. Accumulation/reset semantics depend on server version; plugin count does not imply all are enabled.

plugin_count.zh: 状态接口报告的平台、插件或消息数量；累计口径与重启后是否清零取决于接口版本，不能用插件数量推断全部已启用。
plugin_count.en: Platform, plugin or message count reported by the status API. Accumulation/reset semantics depend on server version; plugin count does not imply all are enabled.

message_count.zh: 状态接口报告的平台、插件或消息数量；累计口径与重启后是否清零取决于接口版本，不能用插件数量推断全部已启用。
message_count.en: Platform, plugin or message count reported by the status API. Accumulation/reset semantics depend on server version; plugin count does not imply all are enabled.

total_message_count.zh: 状态接口报告的平台、插件或消息数量；累计口径与重启后是否清零取决于接口版本，不能用插件数量推断全部已启用。
total_message_count.en: Platform, plugin or message count reported by the status API. Accumulation/reset semantics depend on server version; plugin count does not imply all are enabled.

notice.zh: 服务器返回的通知或运行提示；保留原文方便排查，通知不是客户端确认某项操作已成功的凭据。
notice.en: Server notice or runtime message, retained for troubleshooting. A notice alone is not client verification of an operation.

process.zh: 服务器返回的进程、状态或统计集合。展开查看子项；字段是否存在及统计周期由服务器版本决定，读取状态不会改变服务器配置。
process.en: Server process/status/statistics collection. Expand children; available fields and sampling periods depend on server version. Reading status does not modify configuration.

status.zh: 服务器返回的进程、状态或统计集合。展开查看子项；字段是否存在及统计周期由服务器版本决定，读取状态不会改变服务器配置。
status.en: Server process/status/statistics collection. Expand children; available fields and sampling periods depend on server version. Reading status does not modify configuration.

message_time_series.zh: 服务器返回的进程、状态或统计集合。展开查看子项；字段是否存在及统计周期由服务器版本决定，读取状态不会改变服务器配置。
message_time_series.en: Server process/status/statistics collection. Expand children; available fields and sampling periods depend on server version. Reading status does not modify configuration.

platforms.zh: 服务器返回的进程、状态或统计集合。展开查看子项；字段是否存在及统计周期由服务器版本决定，读取状态不会改变服务器配置。
platforms.en: Server process/status/statistics collection. Expand children; available fields and sampling periods depend on server version. Reading status does not modify configuration.

active_reply.zh: 配置群聊主动回复策略与触发概率，启用后可能在未被点名时发送消息。
active_reply.en: Configure proactive group-reply strategy and probability; enabling may produce replies without a direct mention.

admin.zh: 配置管理员使用本机计算机工具时允许的操作；这是权限矩阵，不是管理员 ID 列表。
admin.en: Permissions for administrators using local computer tools, not the admin ID list.

member.zh: 配置普通成员使用本机计算机工具的权限；应保持任务所需的最小范围。
member.en: Permissions for ordinary members using local computer tools. Keep scope limited to the task.

allow_execution.zh: 允许相应角色通过本机计算机工具执行程序；这可能改变服务器文件或进程，需结合文件系统范围授权。
allow_execution.en: Allow this role to execute programs through local computer tools, potentially changing server files/processes. Combine with filesystem scope.

allow_network.zh: 允许相应角色的本机计算机工具访问网络；授权会影响宿主环境，不能替代网络层隔离。
allow_network.en: Permit network access for this role local computer tools. Applies to the host environment and does not replace network isolation.

baidu_aip.zh: 配置百度内容审核应用及其凭据；服务端需安装 baidu-aip 依赖，启用后将相关内容发送给审核服务。
baidu_aip.en: Configure Baidu moderation credentials. Install baidu-aip on the server; enabling sends relevant content to the moderation service.

config.zh: 当前执行器的参数对象；结构随所选执行器改变，切换后不要把旧执行器对象整体复制过来。
config.en: Parameters for the selected runner. Structure changes with the runner; do not copy a previous runner object wholesale.

file_extract.zh: 控制将用户上传文件转换为模型可读文本的功能；当前来源包含 Moonshot 提取设置，实际支持的文件格式由服务决定。
file_extract.en: Convert uploaded files into text for the model. This baseline includes Moonshot extraction settings; supported file formats depend on the service.

internal_keywords.zh: 按内置和额外关键词规则检查内容；额外规则支持正则，错误规则可能误拦截正常消息。
internal_keywords.en: Check content against built-in and additional keyword rules. Extra patterns support regex; incorrect rules can block normal messages.

moonshotai_api_key.zh: 用于 Moonshot 文件提取服务的 API Key；由 AstrBot 服务器向该服务发送文件，请确认允许上传相关内容。
moonshotai_api_key.en: API key for Moonshot file extraction. The AstrBot server uploads files to that service; confirm the content may be sent.

provider_source_id.zh: 引用已配置的模型服务来源 ID；模型使用该来源的地址和认证，必须与来源列表中的标识精确一致。
provider_source_id.en: Reference an existing provider-source ID for endpoint/authentication. Match the source identifier exactly.

use_file_service.zh: 通过 AstrBot 文件服务 URL 提供合成语音，需要消息平台能访问 callback_api_base 指定的地址，否则可能无法获取音频。
use_file_service.en: Provide synthesized audio through AstrBot file-service URLs. The platform must reach callback_api_base or audio retrieval may fail.

plugin_set.zh: 控制此配置允许使用的插件列表，星号 * 表示全部可用插件，空列表表示不使用任何插件；不能重新启用已在插件页面禁用的插件。上游 UI 元数据虽然标记为 bool，实际保存值为列表，应保留当前服务器返回的列表结构。
plugin_set.en: Allowed plugin list for this configuration. * means all available plugins; an empty list means none. This cannot re-enable plugins disabled on the plugin page. Upstream UI metadata says bool, but the actual stored value is an array: preserve the server structure.

path_mapping.zh: 旧版文件路径映射列表，格式为 原路径:映射路径，供机器人协议端与 AstrBot 文件系统不同的部署使用；文档从 v4.0.0 起已标记废弃。仅在旧服务器确实读取此字段时使用，不应为新部署照搬。
path_mapping.en: Legacy path mappings in original:mapped form for messaging adapters and AstrBot using different filesystems. Documented as deprecated since v4.0.0; use only where an older server actually reads this field.

admins_id.zh: 机器人管理员的用户 ID 列表。给机器人发送 /sid 并按输出区分用户 ID 与会话来源；这里只填用户 ID，不填群号或昵称。列表成员可使用管理员命令，应仅添加受信任账号。
admins_id.en: User IDs allowed to administer the bot. Use /sid and distinguish user IDs from session origins; enter user IDs here, not group IDs or nicknames. Members can run admin commands, so include only trusted accounts.

id_whitelist.zh: 允许机器人响应的会话列表。可填写群号或完整来源，例如 aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789；通过 /sid 获取当前平台的格式。当前源码中空列表不启用拦截，管理员与 WebChat 的豁免规则另行判断，不要统一加 group:。
id_whitelist.en: Sessions allowed to receive bot replies. Match a group ID or full origin such as aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789; obtain the platform format with /sid. An empty list does not filter in this source baseline; admin/WebChat exemptions are checked separately. Do not add group: universally.

platform_settings.id_whitelist.zh: 允许机器人响应的会话列表。可填写群号或完整来源，例如 aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789；通过 /sid 获取当前平台的格式。当前源码中空列表不启用拦截，管理员与 WebChat 的豁免规则另行判断，不要统一加 group:。
platform_settings.id_whitelist.en: Sessions allowed to receive bot replies. Match a group ID or full origin such as aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789; obtain the platform format with /sid. An empty list does not filter in this source baseline; admin/WebChat exemptions are checked separately. Do not add group: universally.
